units.source_text: 在宫中，将以前桐壶更衣所住的淑景舍（即桐壶院）作为源氏公子的住室。

en.t: In the palace, the Shigeisa, where the Kiritsubo Consort had once lived, was made into Prince Genji's residence.

units.source_text: 以前侍候桐壶更衣的侍女，都不遣散，就叫她们侍候源氏公子。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting who had formerly served the Kiritsubo Consort were not dismissed, but were kept on to serve Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 此外，桐壶更衣娘家的邸宅，也由修理职、内匠寮[\[35\]](#part1330.html#m35)奉旨大加改造。

en.t: In addition, the mansion of the Kiritsubo Consort's family was extensively remodeled by imperial order through the Office of Repairs and the Bureau of Skilled Artisans[\[35\]](#part1330.html#m35).

units.source_text: 这里本来有林木假山，风景十分优胜；

en.t: The place already had groves and artificial hills, and its scenery was exceptionally fine;

units.source_text: 现在再将池塘扩充，大兴土木，装点得非常美观。

en.t: now the ponds were further enlarged, major construction was undertaken, and it was adorned until it looked extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 这便是源氏公子的二条[\[36\]](#part1330.html#m36)院私邸。

en.t: This became Prince Genji's private residence at Nijo[\[36\]](#part1330.html#m36) Palace.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想道：“这个地方，让我和我所恋慕的人同住才好。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "How good it would be if I could live here together with the person I long for."
His heart could not help sinking into gloom.
